description: Java entity class representing an OrderProduct in an e-commerce system, including fields for product details, relationships to Order, attributes, prices, and downloads, with persistence annotations.

classes.name: OrderProduct
classes.description: Entity class mapping to ORDER_PRODUCT table, representing a product within an order, with related attributes, prices, and downloads.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key of the order product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key of the order product.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates this order product with an Order.

methods.name: getOrderAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the set of attributes related to this order product.

methods.name: setOrderAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes associated with this order product.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Retrieves the set of prices for this order product.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the prices for this order product.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Returns the set of downloads related to this order product.

methods.name: setDownloads
methods.description: Associates downloads with this order product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU of the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU of the product.

methods.name: getOneTimeCharge
methods.description: Returns the one-time charge for the product.

methods.name: setOneTimeCharge
methods.description: Sets the one-time charge for the product.
